title: verbascum × spurium subsp. foliosum
intro: Verbascum × spurium subsp. foliosum, commonly known as the dwarf mullein, is a rare and unique plant species in the mullein genus. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its soothing and calming effects on the body, making it useful for treating insomnia, anxiety, and other stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Verbascum × spurium subsp. foliosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in herbal medicine.
